help: minus v1.1 RP2354A CLI
version     firmware version, chip id, unique id
rgb R G B [pct]  set the RGB LED (0-255 each): LP5562 U5 over I2C (board 3) at pct % brightness (0-100, default 25 = dim) + the WS2812/SK6812 line (devkit, unscaled), e.g. rgb 255 0 0 100
reboot      reset the RP2354; 'reboot dfu' = reboot into BOOTSEL/UF2 mode
ping        send PING n over UART0 (GPIO16/17), expect PONG n from the PIC32
auto|stop   ping every 500 ms / stop
reset       pulse PIC MCLR low via GPIO24 (needs R53 <= 470R, see README)
rdy         read RDY (GPIO7 <- PIC RA7)
trig        2 us pulse on TRIG (GPIO6 -> PIC RA0)
raw <text>  send <text>\n to the PIC and print whatever comes back within 200 ms
stat        counters
lb          RP UART0 internal loopback self-test

acq [div [samc [in [navg]]]]  capture 4095 ADC samples on the PIC and print them; div = SCCP1 trigger period in 5 ns counts (4 default = 25 Msps: the 32 ns ADC takes every other 20 ns trigger, uniform 40 ns = the DMA cost; 10 = 20 Msps; 5..9 irregular, on the DMA edge), samc = ADC sampling 0..7 (0.5+2n TAD, default 0) or -1 auto, in = input code: 0..15 ADC1 PINSEL, 16..31 ADC2 (25 = AD2AN9 node, default; 9 = AD1AN9 devkit node, 0 OA1OUT, 1 OA1IN+, 17 OA2OUT), navg = 1 single conversion (default) or 2..16 back-to-back conversions summed per trigger (ADC at 40 Msps)

acqcpu [trg [rptcnt [gap [phase]]]]  experiment: CPU-loop capture (no DMA), 4 CPU cycles = 20 ns per read + gap NOPs (conversions are 32 ns: no integer lock since the 200 MHz clock change); trg 12 (default) = SCCP1 at the last acq div, trg 2 back-to-back / 3 repeat timer (dead in single-sample mode, kept for experiments); phase = NOPs before the loop (moves the read off the ADC result write; pairs in the data = wrong phase); uses the last acq input/samc

acqil [div [off [navg]]]  experiment: two ADC1 channels on the same input, navg-sums (default 2) each, triggered half a period apart (div = per-channel period in 5 ns counts, default 24; parked since the 200 MHz / 250 MHz-ADC clock change: two 2-sums of 32 ns conversions no longer fit in one period, needs the 320 MHz ADC clock from PLL2), two DMA channels, interleaved; off = CH1 timer preload in counts (0 = div/2+1)
raw AMP1 0|1  op amp 1 off/on on the PIC (on at boot)
raw AMP2 0|1  op amp 2 off/on on the PIC (off at boot): OA2IN+ = OA1OUT, gain 1 + R_AW(U11)/R49, OA2OUT = FE_A_OUT (J6.2 / RF13, AD2AN1)
pulse [hi [lo [dead]]]  one pulser shot now (board 3, GPIO8/9 -> U3 -> Q1/Q2): +5 V hi ns (200), both off dead ns (27, min 4 cycles), GND lo ns (500), then released
pe [hi [lo [in [dead]]]]  pulse-echo: pulser fires on the PIC's RDY rise = ADC start, 4095 samples at 25 Msps on in (25 = AD2AN9 node default; 0 OA1OUT, 1 LNA/OA1IN+, 17 OA2OUT)
gain [leg [u1 [u2]]]  RX gain (board 3): leg 0..3 = 4052 Rf 2.2k/4.7k/6.8k/10k on both stages (x3.2/x5.7/x7.8/x11 each, Rg 1k); u1/u2 = 1 -> OA1/OA2 at x1 (PIC UGE). No args = show
pc [0|1]    period-4 fixed-pattern correction on the PIC (acq/pe, single conversions; on at boot) + last offsets
i2c         scan the I2C0 bus (MCP4531 x2, MCP4728, OLED)
pot <0|1> [n]  MCP4531 wiper read / set 0..128: 0 = U11 (OA2 feedback: gain x1..x11, power-on 64 = ~x6), 1 = U18 (AD8338)
raw ADCBB n [ovs]  experiment: time n back-to-back ADC conversions (no DMA); reply ADCBB n ovs ticks tick_ns sum
pic ...     ICSP programmer: pic id | image | flash | verify | erase   (pic help)
link [uart|spi [MHz]]  capture payload path: SPI0 frame from the PIC (default, 12.5 MHz, CRC-checked, UART fallback) or UART only (0.7 s); no args = counters
linktest [count [MHz]]  SPI link self-test: PIC LFSR pattern pulled count times (default 10), every word + CRC checked, then once over the UART
dac [off | dc <code> | tri <lo> <hi> <slope> | sine <hz> [amp [mid]]]  PIC DAC1 test signal on DACOUT1 (U9 pin 3, read back with acq 4 0 19); codes 205..3890
gain: gain leg 0 (Rf 2.2k) OA1 x3.20 OA2 x3.20 = x10.2 (20.2 dB, + LNA)
gain 2 0 0: gain leg 2 (Rf 6.8k) OA1 x7.80 OA2 x7.80 = x60.8 (35.7 dB, + LNA)
gain 0 1 1: gain leg 0 (Rf 2.2k) OA1 x1.00 (UGE) OA2 x1.00 (UGE) = x1.0 (0.0 dB, + LNA)
gain 7: usage: gain [leg 0..3 [u1 0|1 [u2 0|1]]]   leg: Rf 2.2k/4.7k/6.8k/10k (x3.2/x5.7/x7.8/x11 per stage); u = 1: that stage x1
gain 0 0 0: gain leg 0 (Rf 2.2k) OA1 x3.20 OA2 x3.20 = x10.2 (20.2 dB, + LNA)
pc: pattern correction ON; last capture offsets (LSB, phase 0..3): +0.25 +0.12 -0.19 -0.25
pc 1: pattern correction ON; last capture offsets (LSB, phase 0..3): +0.25 +0.12 -0.19 -0.25
pulse: pulse: +5V 200.0 ns, off 26.7 ns, GND 500.0 ns, then released (clk_sys 150 MHz)
pulse 100 500 27: pulse: +5V 100.0 ns, off 26.7 ns, GND 500.0 ns, then released (clk_sys 150 MHz)
rgb 1 2 3 101: usage: rgb R G B [pct]  (0-255 each; pct = LP5562 brightness 0-100 %, default 25)
acq 4 0 25 1: # acq n=4095 fill=164.6us fs=24.87Msps rp_fill=162us (RDY window timed by the RP crystal) trigger div 4; in=25 AD2AN9 (PIC32_ADC: OA2OUT after the R67/C86/R68/C87 filter, board 3); navg=1 (12-bit unsigned) link=spi@12.50MHz xfer=10677us
pe: # acq n=4095 fill=164.6us fs=24.87Msps rp_fill=164us (RDY window timed by the RP crystal) pulse-echo: pulse on RDY rise (+5V 200 / off 27 / GND 500 ns), in=25 AD2AN9 (PIC32_ADC: OA2OUT after the R67/C86/R68/C87 filter, board 3), 40 ns/sample; gain leg 0 (Rf 2.2k) OA1 x3.20 OA2 x3.20 = x10.2 (20.2 dB, + LNA); try 1 link=spi@12.50MHz xfer=10660us
pe 200 500 25 27: # acq n=4095 fill=164.6us fs=24.87Msps rp_fill=164us (RDY window timed by the RP crystal) pulse-echo: pulse on RDY rise (+5V 200 / off 27 / GND 500 ns), in=25 AD2AN9 (PIC32_ADC: OA2OUT after the R67/C86/R68/C87 filter, board 3), 40 ns/sample; gain leg 0 (Rf 2.2k) OA1 x3.20 OA2 x3.20 = x10.2 (20.2 dB, + LNA); try 1 link=spi@12.50MHz xfer=10655us
link spi 12.5: link: payload over SPI (UART fallback); SPI0 12.500 MHz (PIC client max 25 MHz); frames ok=23 frame errors=0 uart fallbacks=0 no-reply=0; last frame 8202 B in 10655 us (770 kB/s, incl. the SPIX request)
linktest 3: linktest: 3 frames of 8202 B at 12.500 MHz: ok=3 frame errors=0 pattern errors=0 frames / 0 words, no reply=0
linktest: SPIX request+frame 10629 us mean (min 10621, max 10642) = 772 kB/s; wire time alone 5249 us; 3 frames in 0.04 s
linktest: same buffer over the UART: identical (0 word errors) in 0.71 s
dac tri 512 3584 16: dac: triangle 512..3584 (0.413..2.888 V), slope 16 (12.4 counts per 4 ns step) -> period ~24.58 us (40.69 kHz, nominal)
read it back: acq 4 0 19   (AD2AN3 = DACOUT1, U9 pin 3; board 3: H6.16)
acq 4 0 19 1: # acq n=4095 fill=164.6us fs=24.87Msps rp_fill=162us (RDY window timed by the RP crystal) trigger div 4; in=19 ADC2 input; navg=1 (12-bit unsigned) link=spi@12.50MHz xfer=10651us
dac dc 2048: read it back: acq 4 0 19   (AD2AN3 = DACOUT1, U9 pin 3; board 3: H6.16)
dac sine 20000 800 2048: dac: sine 20000.0 Hz, 50 points, update every 1.00 us, 1.650 V +- 0.645 V (codes 2048 +- 800)
note: each sine update is a DMA transfer that costs the capture DMA ~1 sample: acq/pe at 20-25 Msps come back 'slow'
(bench 2026-11-21). Use 'dac tri' (hardware, no bus traffic) as the reference during captures.
read it back: acq 4 0 19   (AD2AN3 = DACOUT1, U9 pin 3; board 3: H6.16)
link: link: payload over SPI (UART fallback); SPI0 12.500 MHz (PIC client max 25 MHz); frames ok=27 frame errors=0 uart fallbacks=0 no-reply=0; last frame 8202 B in 10651 us (770 kB/s, incl. the SPIX request)
pic help: pic pins    read PGC/PGD/MCLR/RDY/UART_RX levels (who drives what)
pic mclr low|hiz   hold the MCLR tap low for a meter check / release it
pic mclr rise      measure the MCLR node rise time after release (< 5 us = C31 really off)
pic slow|fast      ICSP clock ~100 kHz / ~1.2 MHz (diagnostic; default fast)
pic rdraw [addr [idle [nbits [ncmd]]]]  diagnostic: raw CMDSEQRD bit streams (defaults DEVID 1 33 4)
pic seq <ops> [addr]   diagnostic: S=CMDSEQRD R=CMDRD N=NOP-exec W=MOV.L[W9],[W8] E<hex8>=exec; prints read windows
pic pair 1|2       ICSP pins: 1 = PGC1/PGD1 (GPIO21/22); 2 = PGC2/PGD2 (jumper H2.16 -> CN1.17, PGD2 = TRIG/GPIO6)
pic id      enter ICSP, read DEVID/REVID, exit (no write)
pic image   describe the PIC image embedded in this firmware
pic flash   bulk erase + program + verify the embedded image, then run the PIC
pic verify  compare PIC flash with the embedded image (no write)
pic erase   bulk erase only (PIC is blank afterwards)
needs: R53 = 0R, JP1 cut (C31 off MCLR), nothing plugged on J1
